title: The share rule on net1 v4: copies of itself, and k = 1.5, on validation links
description: Before any test of the share rule (u = 0.125 + k busy max(0, 1 - receive/capacity), experiments/share_rule_export.py), the case it risks: 2 and 4 copies of one controller starting together on each of the 21 validation links for 30 s (experiments/copies.py), for the share rule at k = 0.5, 1, 1.5 and 2, the fixed rule on net1 v4 (u = 0.125), BBRv3, Cubic and BBRv1. Each copy believes it gets a small share, so the share rule may build a standing queue. Reported: each controller's log utility against BBRv3 copies, and Jain's index, utilization and queueing delay of the copies. The five validation families are also run for k = 1.5 next to the fixed rule (k = 0.5, 1, 2 ran in exp-net2v4-val-16).
prepare: G="$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v4" "$G" --u 0.125; uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$G" --u0 0.125 --k 0.5 1 1.5 2; P=(--policy "rule-v4=$OUT/v4/rule-u0.125.onnx"); for k in 0.5 1 1.5 2; do P+=(--policy "share-k$k=$OUT/share/share-u0.125-k$k.onnx"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 11 11 bbr3 --policy "rule-v4=$OUT/v4/rule-u0.125.onnx" --policy "share-k1.5=$OUT/share/share-u0.125-k1.5.onnx"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 11 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3,cubic,bbr "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && uv run python experiments/copies_report.py "$OUT"
